product_one_liner.value: interface.ai provides agentic banking AI that answers and completes transactions for credit unions and community banks.

pricing_page.notes: The company site directs visitors to book a demo; the pricing review reports no public pricing page.

employee_band.notes: The LinkedIn company profile lists 193 employees.

hq_location.notes: The company LinkedIn profile lists San Francisco, California as headquarters; some directories conflict on the city.

founded_year.notes: The company timeline describes 2015–2018 as foundational R&D and says 2019 was when interface.ai was rebranded and launched in the U.S.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index describes articles for banking leaders and the displayed archive is industry/product thought leadership, not an engineering blog.

public_docs.notes: No public product documentation or developer portal was found; the homepage footer links to the Trust Center, not product docs or help.

model_provider.notes: Public product materials describe multiple LLMs but do not name the model provider used by the product.

last_funding.notes: The October 2024 $30M financing included $20M equity and $10M debt; the company timeline describes it as a Series A.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent disclosed funding was in October 2024, before the 18-month window beginning May 2025.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open positions page lists Account Executive and Business Development Representative roles.

launched_6mo.notes: The company introduced its V6 agentic AI platform for summer/fall 2026, with V6 onboarding sessions scheduled in September and October.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A June 2026 company event identifies two new executive hires, including a VP of Sales and an SVP of Customer Experience.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A Sales Operations Manager posting names these as the CRM/GTM toolstack.
